name: Moonshot AI
description: Moonshot AI's Kimi API with OpenAI-compatible chat completions, multimodal inputs, reasoning, structured output, function calling, and account-aware model discovery.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: Moonshot API Key
credential_fields.description: Create an API key in the Kimi API Platform console. Keys are specific to the platform endpoint where they were created.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible Kimi chat completion. Supports model-dependent text, image, and video inputs, reasoning effort, structured output, partial mode, and function calling.

model.description: Native Kimi model ID. Use list_models to discover models and capability flags available to this account.

messages.description: Conversation messages in OpenAI chat format. Content may be text or model-supported text, image_url, and video_url parts.

partial.description: Enable Kimi partial mode on the last assistant message.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens. Limits vary by model.

tool_choice.description: Use auto, none, required, or select a specific function.

response_format.description: Use text, json_object, or json_schema output when supported by the selected model.

stop.description: One stop string or up to five stop strings.

prompt_cache_key.description: Stable session identifier used to improve prompt-cache hits.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List Kimi models available to the connected account, including context length and image, video, and reasoning capability flags.
